title: Band-9 Samples: Do you think you have changed as you have got older? [Why/why not?]
passage_html:
This post contains ideas and band-9 sample answers (audio included) for the Cambridge IELTS 13 Academic Speaking Part 1 Question 3 Test 2 question:

“Do you think you have changed as you have got older? [Why/why not?]”

Sample 1: Yes

Without a doubt, I’ve changed considerably over the years, and a significant area of growth has been in my resilience. Life has thrown many curveballs my way, and each challenge has equipped me with the strength to face the next. Earlier, I would be easily disheartened by setbacks, but now, I see them as opportunities for growth and learning. This increased resilience has made me more adaptable and better prepared to handle life’s unpredictability.

Sample 2: Yes

Unquestionably, aging has brought about a transformation in me. One area where this is most noticeable is in my level of self-awareness. In my youth, I was often unsure of my identity and values. However, as I’ve matured, I’ve taken the time to introspect and understand what truly matters to me. This self-discovery process has made me more confident and secure in my decisions and actions. It feels like I’ve uncovered a deeper, more authentic version of myself.

Sample 3: Yes

Indeed, I’ve undergone significant changes as I’ve aged. This is especially evident in my shifting priorities. As an adolescent, my primary concerns were academic success and fitting in with my peers. As an adult, however, my focus has shifted to maintaining a healthy work-life balance, ensuring financial stability, and nurturing meaningful relationships. It’s interesting to see how my priorities have recalibrated as I’ve navigated through different stages of life.

Sample 4: Yes

Yes, as I’ve journeyed through life, I’ve certainly transformed. One of the profound changes I’ve experienced is a deeper appreciation for life itself. During my younger years, I took many things for granted, such as health, family, and even time. However, as I’ve grown older, I’ve learned to cherish these aspects more. Every moment feels precious, and I try to live each day to the fullest. This newfound gratitude has enriched my life experience tremendously.

Sample 5: No

I reckon that my essence hasn’t altered significantly over the years, even though I’ve engaged in a process of lifelong learning. I’ve acquired new skills and expanded my horizons, but at my core, I am the same individual with the same traits and tendencies.

Sample 6: No

Despite the passage of years, I don’t believe I’ve experienced significant change. My life goals, for instance, have remained largely unaltered. From a young age, I aspired to have a career in healthcare, and that aspiration hasn’t shifted. I’m as determined now to make a difference in people’s lives as I was when I first set foot in my field.

Sample 7: No

Interestingly, I wouldn’t say my personality has gone through any significant alterations as I’ve matured. It’s as if I’ve managed to retain the essence of who I was during my childhood. I was always a quiet, introspective individual who enjoyed spending time alone, reading books, pondering life’s mysteries, and that hasn’t changed. I suppose one might argue that I’ve become more articulate and knowledgeable, but at my core, I remain the same.

Sample 8: No

In my case, I’ve observed an uncanny steadiness in my beliefs and values, regardless of the years passing by. From an early age, I was taught the importance of honesty, kindness, and diligence, and these principles have remained a constant guiding light throughout my life. While my experiences and knowledge have certainly broadened, my core convictions haven’t wavered, making me feel as though little has changed in my persona.

Sample 9: Not Sure

Indeed, it’s quite a conundrum, assessing my own metamorphosis over time. My life has been a series of gradual changes, like the subtle shift from dusk to dawn. These minor adjustments are hardly discernible day-to-day, yet over the years they accumulate into something substantial. Thus, I’m unsure if I can accurately gauge the extent of my transformation.

Sample 10: Not Sure

Well, it’s quite intriguing to ponder upon. I’ve certainly gained more wisdom and experience over the years, but I’m not entirely convinced that these changes signify a transformation in my fundamental self. Maybe it’s more about adapting to the world around me rather than a shift in my core identity.
